en: A color postcard with a burgundy border showing the four towers and façade of a large Romanesque-style basilica rising above green trees and red rooftops. At the top, in an oval cartouche, is the name "PÉCS." The reverse side has standard postcard address lines, a barcode, publisher info, multilingual greeting, and a caption identifying the basilica and photographer.
